senses.gloss:
n. (-दं)
Water.
E.
उन्द to wet, deriv. irr.: see उदक.

ind.
Northern, upper, subsequent: see उदच.

n. (-कं)
Water.
E.
उन्द to wet, deriv. irr.; this is sometimes considered as two words, उद and क, each having the same meaning.

f. (-या)
Presentation of water to ancestors as far as the fourteenth degree.
E.
उदक and क्रिया rite; so उदकर्म्म, &c.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
A giver of water, yielding water, offering water to the manes, &c.
m. (-दः)
An heir, a near kinsman.
E.
उदक and द who gives; also उदकदातृ and उदकदायिन्.

n. (-नं)
Gift of water, especially to the manes, as a religious or obsequial rite.
E.
उदक and दान giving.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Giving water.
m. (-यी)
An heir or kinsman, one who presents libations of water.
E.
उदक and दायिन् who gives.

ind.
Pouring water on the hand as preparatory to or confirmatory of a gift or promise.
E.
उदक and पूर्व्वक prior.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Watery, fluid like water.
E.
उदक and प्रतीकाश what resembles.

m. (-हः)
A variety of Diabetes, passing watery urine.
E.
उदक and मेह urining.

n. (-कं)
Any aquatic herb.
E.
उदक and शाक a potherb.

mfn. (-र्शः)
1 Touching different parts of the body with water.
2 Touching water in confirmation of a promise, &c.
E.
उदक and स्पर्श touch.

m. (-रः)
A reservoir, a cistern, a well, &c.
E.
उदक and आधार receptacle.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Thirsty, desirous of water.
E.
उदक and अर्थिन् who seeks.

m. (-र्य्यः)
A plant, (Galedupa arborea, &c.) see करञ्जक.
E.
उद water, and कॄ to scatter, अच् aff.

m. (-म्भः)
A water jar.
E.
उद and कुम्भ a jar; also उदककुम्भ.

m. (-नः)
A water jar.
E.
उकक and उदञ्चन what goes up.

n. (-रं)
Dropsy.
E.
उदक् and उदर the belly.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Gone up, risen, ascended.
E.
उद before अञ्च to go, क्त aff.

f. (-क्या)
A woman in her courses.
E.
उदक water, and यत् affix of fitness: requiring water for purification.

m. (-द्रिः)
The Himālaya mountains on the north of Hindustan.
E.
उदक north, and अद्रि a mountain.

n. (-नं)
The sun's progress north of the equator: see उत्तरायण.
E.
उदक् north, and अयन going.

m. (-मः)
Good soil.
E.
उदक् north, भूमि earth, अण् aff.

m. (मिः)
Fertile soil: see the preceding.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
1 High, tall.
2 Large, vast.
3 Projecting.
4 Pointing upwards.
5 Fierce, intense.
E.
उत् up, and अग्र end, point.

mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्)
Large toothed.
m. (-दन्)
An elephant with a large tusk.
E.
उदग्र large, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खा-खं)
Facing the north.
E.
उदच् and मुख face.

उदच् or उदञ्च्
mfn. (उदङ् उदीची उदक्)
1 North, northern.
2 Upper, upwards.
3 Subsequent, posterior.
f. (-दीची)
The north.
E.
उद् up, अञ्च to go, affix क्विप्; the neuter is used as a particle: see उदक्; the noun is irregular.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Aquatic, watery, produced in or by water.
m. (-जः)
Driving cattle.
E.
उद water, and ज born, or उद् up, and अज to go, affix अप्.

m. (-जः)
Commanding, directing bodies of men.
E.
उद before अज to go, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 A lid or cover.
2 Directing or throwing upwards.
3 Rising, ascending.
E.
उद above, अञ्च to go, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thrown up, tossed.
2 Worshipped.
E.
उद् up, अञ्च to go or worship, affix क्त.

m. (-लः)
1 A kind of fish.
2 A sort of snake.
E.
उद् much, अण्ड an egg, and पाल what nourishes; laying many eggs at once.

m. (-लः)
1 A sort of snake.
2 A kind of fish.
3 A punisher, whether king or magistrate.
E.
उद् above, दण्डपाल a punisher.

m. (-धिः)
1 The ocean.
2 A water jar.
2 A cloud.
E.
उद् water, and धि having, from धा, with कि aff.

m. (-क्राः)
A voyager, a mariner.
E.
उदधि, क्रम to go, विट् aff.

m. (-लः)
Cuttle fish bone.
E.
उदधि and मल soil.

f. (-ला)
The earth.
E.
उदधि and मेखला a girdle.

f. (-ता)
1 LAKṢMĪ.
2 Dvārakā, the capital of KṚṢṆA.
E.
उदधि the ocean, and सुता daughter.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A pure and virtuous man.
2 Tidings, intelligence.
3 One who gets a livelihood by a trade, &c.
E.
उद् disjunctive, and अन्त end, term.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Energetic.
2 Humble.
3 Elevated.
4 Vomited by an elephant.
E.
उद and दान्त tamed.

m. (-कः)
News, tidings, intelligence.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-का)
Satisfaction, satiety.
E.
उद् complete, अन्त end, कन् aff.

f. (-न्या)
Thirst.
E.
उदक् water, क्यच् affix, the final क is changed to न.

m. (-न्वान्)
The ocean.
E.
उद् water, and मतुप् possessive aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A water cup, a ewer.
E.
उद् and पात्र a vessel.

mn. (-नः-नं)
1 A well.
E.
उद् water, पा to drink, and ल्युट् affix; the place where water is drunk.

n. (-षं)
A paste, any thing ground with water.
E.
उद and पेष grinding.

m. (-रः)
1 A cloud.
2 A water carrier.
E.
उद and भार a load.

m. (-न्थः)
Barley water.
E.
उद and मन्थ scum; also, उदकमन्थ.

m. (-घः)
A watery cloud.
E.
उद and मेघ a cloud.

m. (-यः)
1 The rising of the sun and planets in general.
2 The eastern mountain, behind which the sun is supposed to rise.
3 Rising, ascending.
4 Light, splendor.
5 Prosperity, good fortune.
6 Creation, the rising of the world.
7 (In law) Income.
E.
उद् up, इण to go, and अच् aff.

n. (-नं)
Rising, ascending.
m. (-नः)
1 A name of AGASTYA: see अगस्त्य.
2 The name of a sovereign, king of Kauśāmbī, and hero of the Vāsavadattā, a dramatic poem; also, of part of the Vṛhat Kathā.
E.
उद् above, इण to go, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-तः)
The eastern mountain behind which the sun rises.
E.
उदप and पर्ब्वत a mountain; also similar compounds, as उदयगिरिः, उदयशैलः, उदयाचलः, उदयाद्रिः, &c.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Rising, ascending.
2 Prosperous, flourishing.
E.
उदय and इनि aff.

n. (-रं)
1 The belly.
2 War.
3 Any morbid abdominal affection, as liver, spleen, &c.
f. (-री)
Enlargement of the abdomen from dropsy or flatulency.
E.
उद् up, ऋ to go, अप् affix; what goes up or swells with food, slaughter, &c. or उद् prefixed to दृ to burst, and अच् or अल् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Generous, liberal, munificent.
2 Great.
3 Unperplexed.
4 Gentle.
5 Upright, honest, sincere.
6 Eloquent.
7 Proper, right.
E.
उद् well, आङ् prefixed to ऋ to go, and अप् affixed.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Rubbing the belly, &c.
2 Abdominal.
E.
उदर and कन् aff.

m. (-न्थिः)
The spleen, (the disease; a chronic affection of this organ not uncommon in India.)
E.
उदर abdomen, and ग्रन्थि a knot.

n. (-णं)
1 A cuirass, armour covering the front.
2 A girth, a belly band.
E.
उदर the belly, and त्राण what preserves: see उदरस्त्राण.

m. (-थिः)
1 The ocean.
2 The sun.
E.
उद् freely, ऋ to go, and अथिर् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
A glutton, voracious, one who devours every thing, flesh, fish, &c.
E.
उदर and पिशाच a demon, who is a devil for his belly.

mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि)
Selfishly voracious, gluttonous.
E.
उदर, भृ to nourish, इन् affix, and मुम् is inserted.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Sleeping on the face or belly.
E.
उदर and शय who sleeps.

m. (-यः)
Dysentery, diarrhoea^1.
E.
उदर the belly, and आमय sickness.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-र्त्तः)
The navel.
E.
उदर and आवर्त्त whirl.

m. (-ष्टः)
Tape worm.
E.
उदर and आवेष्ट what surrounds.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Fat, corpulent.
2 Abdominal.
f. (-णी)
A pregnant woman.
E.
उदर the belly, इनि possessive aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Fat, corpulent.
E.
उदर to belly, and इलच् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Future or remote consequence.
2 Future time.
3 A plant, (Vangueria spinosa): see मदन.
E.
उद् much, ऋच् to praise, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि)
Luminous and ascending.
m. (-र्च्चिः)
1 A name of VAHNI or fire.
2 ŚIVA.
3 KANDARPA.
E.
उद upwards, and अर्च्चिस् flame.

m. (-र्दः)
Erysipelas.
E.
उद् up, अर्द to go, अच् aff.

m. (-र्द्धः)
Scarlet fever.
E.
उद and ऋध to increase, अच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Salted, prepared with brine.
E.
उद water, लवण salt, and ठक् aff.

m. (-ज्रः)
A thunderbolt of water, a water spout.
E.
उद and वज्र a thunderbolt.

n. (-तं)
A house.
E.
उद water, and वसित covered, defended, deriv. irr.

n. (-सं)
1 A house in the margin of a stream or pond.
2 A marine grotto, &c.
E.
उद् and वास a bode.

m. (-नः)
1 A cloud.
2 Any water vessel.
E.
उद and वाहन vehicle.

m. (-न्दुः)
A drop of water.
E.
उद and विन्दु a drop.

n. (-श्वित्)
Buttermilk, with an equal proportion of water.
E.
उद water, श्वि to increase, affixes क्विप् and तुक्.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Cast, thrown.
2 Expelled, cast out.
3 Cast up.
4 Humbled, shamed.
5 Scattered.
6 Removed.
E.
उद् before अस to throw, क्त aff.

f. (-ली)
A caldron, a kettle.
E.
उद and स्थाली a pot.

ind.
1 Having taken pains, made an effort, &c.
2 Having thrown, having cast up or tossed.
3 Having scattered.
4 Having expelled.
E.
उद् before अस to be or throw, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A water carrier.
2 A cloud.
E.
उद् and हार who takes.

m. (-रः)
See the preceding.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Generous, gentle and bountiful.
2 Giving, a donor.
3 Great, illustrious.
4 Dear, beloved.
5 Accented.
m. (-त्तः)
1 The acute accent, a high or sharp tone.
2 Gift, donation.
3 A musical instrument, a large drum.
4 An ornament, (in rhetoric.)
E.
उद high, up, and आत्त pronounced, sounded; or from दा, to give or have, with आङ् prefixed, affix क्तः see अनुदात्त.

m. (-नः)
1 One of the five vital airs, that which rises up the throat and passes into the head.
2 The navel.
3 A snake.
4 An eye-lash.
E.
उद् above, आङ् prefixed to अण् to breathe, to be, affix घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 Binding, confinement.
2 Taming, subduing.
3 A fire place.
4 Submarine fire.
5 The middle, the waist.
6 The entrance of the sun into a sign of the zodiac.
E.
उद reverse, and दा to give, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः)
High-minded, magnanimous.
E.
उदार and चेतस् the mind.

mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि)
Wise, sagacious, noble-minded.
E.
उदार and धी Understanding.

m. (-रः)
A year, one of the five sorts of years astrologically considered.
E.
उद् and आङ् before वत्सर a year.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A disease of the bowels, iliac passion.
f. (-ता)
Difficult menstruation.
E.
उद् upper, आवर्त्त abode.

m. (-सः)
1 Throwing or directing upwards.
2 Elevation, being above or over.
3 A stoic, a philosopher.
4 Stoicism.
mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Indifferent, unconcerned, apathetic.
E.
उद् and आस who casts.

mfn. (-ता-त्रै-तृ)
Indifferent, disregarding, void of concern or affection.
E.
उद् before आस to cast, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Indifferent, disregarding.
m. (-सी)
A stoic, a philosopher, one who has no passion nor affection for any thing: in popular acceptation, a religious mendicant in general, or one of a particular order.
E.
उदास and इमि aff.

mfn. (नः-ना-नं)
1 Indifferent, free from affection. (In law) One not involved in the dispute.
m. (-नः)
A stranger, a neutral, a common acquaintance, a person neither a friend nor a foe.
E.
उद् above, आसीन seated.

m. (-तः)
1 A spy, an emissary.
2 A doorkeeper.
3 A superintendent.
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Set over.
E.
उद् over, आङ् before स्था to stay, affix क्त.

n. (-णं)
1 An example or illustration, an apposite argument, one of five modes of logical reasoning.
2 Declaring, saying.
E.
उद् over, आङ् before हृ to convey, and ल्युट् affix, or with घञ् affix उदाहार.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Called, named, entitled.
2 Said.
3 Illustrated.
E.
उद् and आङ् before हृ to take, affix क्त.

m. (-शः)
A bug.
E.
उद् much, and दंश who bites, from दशि and अच् aff.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Raised on a staff or pole.
E.
उद and दण्ड a stick.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 High, tall.
2 Terrific, formidable.
3 Large toothed.
E.
उद high, long, and दन्तुर large toothed.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Set free, unbound.
2 Unconstrained, self-willed.
2 Large, great.
4 Proud, haughty.
m. (-मः)
A name of VARUṆA.
E.
उद priv. दम to tame, and घञ् aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A plant, (Cordia myxa or latifolia.)
2 A kind of grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.)
E.
उद high, large दल to pierce, affix घञ्; also उद्दालक, क being added.
